svg.title: Perovskite solar modules task routes
svg.desc: All operations in the first or designated complete reference route, plus the full branch index. Dashed connectors show authored reference order only. Loop bodies are shown once with original loop metadata in the interactive inspector. No scientific execution claimed.
svg.text: 752 operation definitions · 40 route / branch records · 0 validated runnable whole-paper tasks
DESIGN REFERENCE ONLY · Reported scientific stages + separately authored robot handling
Dashes = reference display order, not proven source chronology. Branch choices are not connected to each other.
